svg.title: Loading multiple hazard GeoTIFFs from a CSV
svg.desc: A hazards CSV lists one GeoTIFF per ARI: 10, 50, 100 and 250. Two exposures, B1 Timber and B2 Concrete, are each sampled against every GeoTIFF, so the output has eight rows: each exposure once per ARI.
svg.text: Each exposure appears once per ARI (2 exposures × 4 ARIs = 8 rows)
